rows.ts_value:
Covenant: maximum Net Leverage Ratio of 4.00x, tested at each fiscal quarter-end on a trailing four-quarter basis. Numerator: Consolidated Total Indebtedness plus capitalised Operating Lease Obligations, minus unrestricted cash up to $200m. Denominator: Consolidated EBITDAR.

Step-up: on a Transition Period Election after a Material Acquisition, the maximum is 4.50x 'for the four quarters following the Material Acquisition'. No more than two elections, with at least two full fiscal quarters between Transition Periods.

EBITDAR add-backs: extraordinary, non-recurring, unusual or exceptional items (with a matching deduction for such gains), and run-rate savings with an 18-month look-forward (12 months for cost synergies), capped at 15%.

No equity cure.

TS: 'Summary of Terms and Conditions' (a term sheet) for a $1,000 million Revolving Credit Facility for Michael Kors (USA), Inc., Capri Holdings Limited, Michael Kors (Europe) B.V., Michael Kors (Canada) Holdings Ltd. and Michael Kors (Switzerland) GmbH. It is marked 'Posting Version 6/5/2026' and runs 14 PDF pages, including Annex I (Interest and Certain Fees) and Annex I-A (pricing grid). Many TS terms simply refer back to the Existing Credit Agreement (the A&R Credit Agreement dated February 4, 2025).

CA: Amendment No. 1 dated June 24, 2026 (filed as Exhibit 10.1), a Refinancing Amendment under Section 2.27 that replaces the $1.5bn of existing revolving commitments with $1.0bn of 2026 Revolving Commitments (PDF pp.1-24). It attaches Exhibit A, a blackline of the A&R Credit Agreement 'Conformed through Amendment No. 1' (PDF pp.26-202). The reconciliation is against the agreement as amended.

Limitations:
(1) Exhibit A is a blackline, and the pdftotext output runs deleted and inserted text together (for example '$1,500,000,0001,000,000,000', 'July 1June 24, 20272031', 'Pricing Level 12' and the grid rows). Struck text was identified from the strike-through lines drawn in the PDF, using the read-only helper the first analyst left in the scratchpad (tools\pdfmark.py). In this review it was only re-run, printing to stdout; no files were created or changed. Some CA quotes therefore contain struck text, and each affected row explains this.
(2) Annex I (each lender's 2026 Revolving Commitment), Schedule 2.01(a), Schedule 2.02 (each Issuing Bank's LC commitment) and every schedule other than Schedule 1.01 are missing from the CA PDF. Lender allocations and LC commitments could not be checked.
(3) Where the TS says 'Same as the Existing Credit Agreement', CA provisions with no blackline changes were treated as matching. The Existing Credit Agreement itself was not provided separately.
(4) PDF page rendering was not available (pdftoppm is not installed). Neither pdftotext -layout nor -raw extracts the 'less than or equal to' symbols in the TS Annex I-A grid. The TS thresholds were read as upper bounds from the grid structure (Level 4 is '> 3.50:1.00'), and the CA grid's ≤ symbols were confirmed by the PDF strike parse.

Key findings:
(a) A12: the amendment deletes the Schedule 1.01 paragraph that defined 'Adjustment Date' and 'Pricing Level'. Section 1.01 still cross-refers to it, so the conformed CA does not say when grid pricing takes over from the initial Level 2 pricing. The TS ties the switch to the first compliance certificate. The unstruck 'Public Debt Rating' definition (PDF pp.73-74) also still contains ratings-based Pricing Level rules, although the grid no longer has a ratings column.
(b) A19: the CA allows 3-month Interest Periods in every currency and uses 365/366-day counts for GBP, JPY and CAD; the TS wording differs on both. Both differences are minor and favour the borrower.
(c) Minor mechanical differences in A04 (availability ends 'to but excluding' the maturity date), A14 (fronting fee base and timing) and A17 (LC revaluation dates).
(d) X01 was added for the TS 'Refinancing Facilities' term (CA Section 2.27).

TS: 'Summary of Terms and Conditions' for a $1,000 million revolving credit facility for Michael Kors (USA), Inc., Capri Holdings Limited, Michael Kors (Europe) B.V., Michael Kors (Canada) Holdings Ltd. and Michael Kors (Switzerland) GmbH. It is marked 'Posting Version 6/5/2026', runs to 14 PDF pages and includes Annex I (interest and fees) and Annex I-A (pricing grid). For most terms it says they will be 'substantially the same as' the Existing Credit Agreement, the Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated February 4, 2025. Its side headings do not line up with the paragraphs in the text extraction, especially on pages 4 and 6-10, so each paragraph was matched to its heading by order on the page.

CA: Amendment No. 1 dated June 24, 2026. It is a Refinancing Amendment under Section 2.27 of the A&R Credit Agreement dated February 4, 2025, with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as Administrative Agent. Annex I replaces the existing revolving commitments with 2026 Revolving Commitments. The operative terms are in Exhibit A, a blackline 'Conformed through Amendment No. 1' that starts at PDF page 26. Each row was reconciled against the agreement as amended, meaning the Amendment No. 1 body plus Exhibit A.

Limitations and method:

(1) Exhibit A is a blackline. In the text extraction, deleted and inserted words run together, for example '$1,500,000,0001,000,000,000', 'March 3028, 20242026' and 'EBITDAREBITDA'. Deleted words that stand alone, such as 'Italy, ', are not marked at all. The page images could not be rendered because pdftoppm is not installed. Instead, the strike-through lines (about 2.4pt above the baseline) and underlines (about 1.8pt below it) were decoded from the vector drawing operators in the PDF content streams for the key pages: 33, 39, 42-46, 51, 58, 63-68, 73, 81, 83-84, 86-88, 141, 146, 150-154, 157, 160, 164-165, 167-168, 170, 181-182 and 199-200. Underlining also marks defined terms and words like 'provided', so not every underline is an insertion.

This decoding confirmed that deleted text comes before inserted text. It also found deletions the text does not show:
- Material Subsidiary and Secured Net Leverage Ratio now use Consolidated EBITDA instead of EBITDAR.
- Italy is deleted from 'IP Subsidiary', 'Eligible Jurisdiction' and the s.5.09(c) IP filing list, together with all Italian-law definitions and the Italian wording in Article VII(j).
- Former s.9.20 (Italian Transparency Rules) is deleted, and Special Amendment Provisions is renumbered from 9.21 to 9.20.
- The Initial USD and Euro Term Loan facilities are deleted throughout, so the Lenders are now only Revolving Lenders unless incremental term loans are added.
- The collateral fall-away and springback (s.5.09(d)-(g)) and the 'Investment Grade Rating' definition are new insertions.

(2) Annex I (each lender's commitment) and most schedules (1.01(b)-(d), 3.01, 3.06, 6.01, 6.02 and 6.04) are not in the extracted text. Only the pricing grid schedule is.

(3) The Existing Credit Agreement was not provided. Where the TS only says 'same as' or 'consistent with' it, the check confirms that the CA has a matching provision and, using the blackline, whether Amendment No. 1 changed it. It cannot confirm the original Existing CA wording.

(4) The cover page of Exhibit A still lists the 2025 titled agents. The 2026 roles are in the Amendment No. 1 recitals and the amended 'Lead Arrangers' and 'Co-Documentation Agents' definitions.

(5) Page references use the PDF page markers. The printed page numbers in the CA are different.

(6) All ts_quote and ca_quote values were checked mechanically against the text files, with whitespace collapsed. Some CA quotes (B01, B02, B05, X11) contain blackline-merged or struck words exactly as they appear in the extraction; the ca_value fields describe the text as amended.
